title: Generator tokenizer hangs on an unsupported DSL byte
summary: The tokenizer could hang on unsupported bytes and accept keyword prefixes such as driverXYZ. The owner approved the concrete tokenizer/exact-keyword repair on2026-11-02. Unsupported tokens now fail with position diagnostics and exact keywords are required. Four bounded regressions pass; generated output remains byte-identical for120 valid maintained driver definitions. See linked repair verification for approval, commands and limits.
